claim-caveman-no-telemetry.statement: The Caveman proxy launchd script and the pi shim set DO_NOT_TRACK=1, so Caveman telemetry stays off for the proxy and the hook CLI.

claim-headroom-state-on-volume.statement: The evaluated headroom-proxy launchd agent passes HEADROOM_WORKSPACE_DIR=/data and HEADROOM_MEMORY_DB_PATH=/data/memory.db, and no HEADROOM_STORE_URL or HEADROOM_SAVINGS_PATH.
